snippet.title: MOM FULL Game Walkthrough / Playthrough - Let's Play (No Commentary)
snippet.description:
MOM By cursedcat Ending 2 Horror Adventure Game Part 1 to Ending [Microsoft Windows]

In this story, you will control Riley, a girl who has noticed a grotesque change in her mother’s behavior over time, putting her in various challenging situations from which you must help her escape unharmed.

MOM: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3255100/MOM/
Developer: cursedcat
Genres: Horror, Adventure
Platforms: Microsoft Windows
